metadata.title: Deforming area-preserving maps between surfaces by mean curvature flow coupled with Ricci flow
metadata.abstract: We study a natural way to deform area-preserving maps between compact Riemann surfaces. Specifically, we evolve the metrics on the two Riemann surfaces by the normalized Ricci flow and the graph of the area-preserving map by the mean curvature flow. We prove that the flow exists for all time, remains the graph of an area-preserving map, and converges smoothly and exponentially to a minimal Lagrangian graph with respect to the product of the limiting metrics. This generalizes earlier results of Wang and Smoczyk, in which the Riemann surfaces have constant scalar curvature.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 通过两曲面的归一化 Ricci 流与面积保持映射图像的平均曲率流耦合，将映射长期变形并指数收敛到极限度量下的极小 Lagrangian 图像。
analysis.breakthrough: 从常标量曲率背景推进到随时间演化的曲面度量。
analysis.limitations: 紧曲面与耦合设置不可省略；指数收敛及初始度量的完整兼容条件需核对正文。 数学分析仅依据摘要及评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索和命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 几何流耦合与图像保持机制具有较高可复用性。
